registration: After observing the old ordinary blend trail its single contextual constituent on the first outer training panel. Do not score new work again on that panel.
data: Use only the anonymous 6493-row training packet from round one. Use a fixed opaque seed (AIAA new training partition blend qualification v1) to form five grouped stratified folds. Evaluate the first three disjoint folds in order. Rows have been used in prior development; these are new partitions, not new customers or a new task. Do not use the previous outer 1624, designated validation or test.
arms: On each fold run cold from identical anonymous training and unlabelled queries, first the 32-fit full catalogue and protected exploration (55b4ab41), then the same catalogue and cap with a last, separate training-only blend check. All selection may decline new models. Working time is capped at 1800 seconds per run; language model requests 0.
change: Exclude one grouped training holdout from all search trial fits. If a soft vote is proposed, freeze its two components and elect the better individual using only matching search scores. Average each member's stored predictions across common search fits on the separate holdout. Keep the pair only when its primary metric gain against the locked single is at least .003 pooled and nonnegative on both group-preserving halves. If the search proposes a single, keep it. Always refit the selected solution on all available training inputs. Record when reserving examples changes the search itself.
gate: Freeze all six ordinary results and independently reload each solution before opening the three outer answer files. Advance the new policy only if at least two folds improve, none lose more than .003 and the pooled gain is at least .003. Record each paired change, all methods actually used and the paired grouped bootstrap interval. A positive result qualifies a single comparison of the frozen policy against the native ten-fit anchor on course validation, otherwise maintain the historical release.
